content.info: Light keeps chats and every message, contacts, groups, identities, wallets and settings. It leaves out the files over 1 MB; voice messages up to 4 MB stay. After a restore, each file left out shows as Not in this backup.
content.label: Contents
content.leftOut: Files over 1 MB were left out ({{size}}).

backups.emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a backup file.
backups.holds: In it: chats and their keys, messages, files of any size, wallets, shared apps and settings. Not in it: S3 storage keys, this device's notification subscription, files still arriving, and the local data of Bark, Spark and Fedimint wallets, which come back from their recovery phrase (the phrase is in the backup).
backups.keepOne: Original still here? Keep using just one: they share wallets.

protection.confirm: I understand. Make it without a passphrase.
protection.label: Protection
protection.mainnet: This profile has Mainnet wallets that have held real money. Whoever gets the file can spend it.
protection.warning: Not encrypted. The file holds this profile's keys, chats and wallet secrets in the clear. Anyone who gets the file gets everything in it, including any money in its wallets.

s3.note: Keys stay on this device. The bucket must allow this app in its CORS rules.
s3.title: S3 storage

sameDevice.firstProfile: The first profile can't be removed. To replace it, clear its data in Settings.
sameDevice.hint: Both would act as the same person to your contacts. Replace the original, or don't run both.
sameDevice.info: A restored copy keeps the original's chat keys. With both running, they answer the same contacts as one person and compete for the same connections, so messages can land in either. Replace restores the copy, switches to it, then offers to remove the original with the usual checks: what it holds, a backup first, and its name to confirm.
